Name: Pelican Town Taxes Special Order
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
[b]Pelican Town Taxes Special Order[/b]
Do you like to complete special orders?
Do you want to help the town?
Do you ever wonder where Mayor Lewis got the gold for his statue? 
Do you need to get friendship points with Lewis?
This mod creates a special order where you have to deliver 10 gold bars to Lewis to pay your taxes. After you complete the special order, you will receive 500 friendship points with Lewis and thank you letters from business owners.

[b]Translations[/b]
Translations are welcome. Please let me know and link the translation to this mod.
Chinese (zh) translation by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/FaithQ?pk_vid=009142b4768144fc1753810683faa594]FaithQ 
[/url]Updated by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/lllluby]lllluby
[/url]
[b]Insulation[/b]
·      Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.﻿﻿
·      Download and Extract Content Patcher mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
·      Download and Extract [b]Game Achievements Thank you letters[/b] into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿﻿﻿
·      Launch Stardew Valley. 


I hope you enjoy this mod and take a look at my other mods. 
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/sadnumbme]sadnumbme[/url]
